contexts.text: The affection of knowledges of the external man is the Egyptian handmaid Hagar.
Her name was Hagar () = the life of the exterior or natural man.
Hagar means a sojourner, or one who is sojourning; and sojourners represented those who were being instructed...
Hagar her Egyptian handmaid () = the life of the exterior man, and the affection of knowledges.

He entered to Hagar () = the conjunction of the internal man with the life which is of the affection of knowledges. Hagar = the life of the exterior or natural man, which life is the life of the affection of knowledges. Explained.
Hagar the Egyptian = the affection of knowledges.
He said, Hagar, handmaid of Sarai () = information.
It is Hagar who is here speaking, by whom is signified the life of knowledges, which is of the exterior man, because from this life the first Rational originated.
Hagar bare Abram a son () = the rational man born of that conception and conjunction... Hagar = the life of the affection of knowledges of the exterior man.
When Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram () = when the life of the affection of knowledges brought forth the Rational. Explained.

The first Rational can be conceived no otherwise than by the influx of the internal man into the affection of knowledges of the external; nor be otherwise born than from the affection of knowledges which is represented by Hagar the handmaid of Sarai.
It treats of the merely human Rational, which is the son of Hagar the Egyptian.
The separation of the maternal human... is represented by the son of Hagar being sent out of the house.
The son of Hagar the Egyptian () = into the merely human Rational. Hagar the Egyptian = the affection of knowledges from which this Rational is born as a mother.
By the son of Hagar and his mother is represented the Spiritual Church.
It now treats of those who are of the Spiritual Church, who are signified by the son of Hagar, after he had been sent away.

He gave them to Hagar () = implantation in his life. Hagar = the life of the exterior man. The life of the exterior man is the affection of knowledges, which is signified in special by Hagar the Egyptian. Explained. AC 3264.

The reason the voice of the boy, and not that of Hagar, is said to have been heard, is that it treats of the state of the spiritual man: by the boy, or Ishmael, is represented the man of the Spiritual Church; by Hagar his mother, its affection of the Knowledges of truth, which is what suffers grief... Hagar, here, = the affection of the Knowledges of truth.

The Angel of God cried to Hagar out of Heaven () = consolation... Hagar = the affection of the Knowledges of truth; and the influx of the Lord into the affection of truth, when this is in the deepest grief on account of deprivation, is consolation.
This was represented by Hagar who was betrothed to Abraham. Explained.
Mentioned.
